messages.snippet: Hey Mom, just checking about fall break plans

payload.body:
Hey Mom,

Just confirming I'm coming home Oct 23! My last class is at 11 AM and I'll catch the 1:30 PM bus. Should get to the station around 5ish.

Can we do tonkotsu ramen that night? I've been craving it since September.

Also Kenji said he'd pick me up from the station if you and Dad are busy.

Love you!
Hana
